grade_label.fit_to_quote: No slip, or at most two that mislead no one
grade_label.fit_to_read: Three or more slips, none of which misleads
grade_label.search_only: At least one reading that changes the sense
grade_label.wrong_span: A span the page does not carry: a word, a number, a dropped phrase
grade_label.from_elsewhere: A span from somewhere else: invented, recited, or another leaf
grade_label.not_this_page: Not this page's text at all (fidelity 1)

band_label.fit_to_quote: No slip, or at most two that mislead no one
band_label.fit_to_read: Three or more slips, none of which misleads
band_label.some_errors: Some errors that may change the meaning: 1 or 2 on the page
band_label.many_errors: Many errors that may change the meaning: 3 or more on the page
band_label.from_elsewhere: A span from somewhere else: invented, recited, or another leaf
band_label.not_this_page: Not this page's text at all (fidelity 1)

band_sensitivity.rule: 3 or more misleads / wrong_text spans on the page
band_sensitivity.alternative: 10 or more such spans per 1,000 units (words; Han characters; Tibetan syllables)
